@Bhalisa_M_Sodo @RancidPotato @theonevortex @cryptomanran @dogecoin @SiaTechHQ Cryptocurrencies can be used not only by investors right? Just the same example — #Siacoin has quite an interesting utility and can be used by many people/organizations but it’s unlikely it is a store of value.

@Bhalisa_M_Sodo @theonevortex @cryptomanran @dogecoin @SiaTechHQ Just ask yourself how many coins among these will exist in ten years. Store of value is about long term — not even decades but hundreds and thousands of years.

@Bhalisa_M_Sodo @theonevortex @cryptomanran @dogecoin @SiaTechHQ SoV is not inherently a function/property of a cryptocurrency. Limited coins supply, anti-fragility ect are necessary. There can be a cryptocurrency with a lot of properties and functions but not a SoV.
